tasks.description: Add the collapsed-width rule to the pure, Qt-free dock model: `WATCHLIST_COLLAPSED_WIDTH = 30`; a single pure `plan_watchlist_width(chart_area_w, requested_left, collapsed=False)` helper; a `left_collapsed` mode on `plan_dock_widths` that fixes a collapsed left at the collapsed width (its own floor becomes 30, the cross-clamp may shrink only the right, the `chart_area_w - left - right >= CHART_MIN_WIDTH` budget is unchanged, and the infeasible branch returns `(WATCHLIST_COLLAPSED_WIDTH, RIGHT_DOCK_MIN_WIDTH)`); and `clamp_watchlist_width` delegating to the new helper with `collapsed=False`. Extend `tests/test_dock_layout.py` (the collapsed pure cases + the constants test) and `tests/test_watchlist.py` (the collapsed delegate case). The 3-argument expanded call must keep today's behaviour bit-for-bit.
acceptance_criteria: AC1 — AC-D44.1 / AC-D44.5 (the pure collapsed rule) — Given the pure helper `plan_watchlist_width(chart_area_w, requested_left, collapsed=False)`, When `collapsed=True`, Then it returns `WATCHLIST_COLLAPSED_WIDTH` for every `chart_area_w` and `requested_left`; When `collapsed=False`, Then it returns `max(WATCHLIST_MIN_WIDTH, min(int(requested_left), watchlist_max_width(chart_area_w)))` — exactly today's `clamp_watchlist_width` formula.

AC2 — AC-D44.5 / DG74 (the collapsed left in the B3 cross-clamp) — Given `plan_dock_widths(chart_area_w, requested_left, requested_right, left_collapsed=True)`, Then the returned left is always `WATCHLIST_COLLAPSED_WIDTH`; the returned right stays within `[RIGHT_DOCK_MIN_WIDTH, right_dock_max_width(chart_area_w)]`; the cross-clamp may shrink only the right (the left never rises above the collapsed width); `chart_area_w - left - right >= CHART_MIN_WIDTH` holds wherever feasible; on an infeasible window the result is `(WATCHLIST_COLLAPSED_WIDTH, RIGHT_DOCK_MIN_WIDTH)`; and over the whole T52 grid with `left_collapsed=True` the function never raises and returns stable ints.

AC3 — AC-D44.8 (the expanded contract is preserved bit-for-bit) — Given the existing 3-argument positional call `plan_dock_widths(chart_area_w, requested_left, requested_right)`, Then every result is unchanged from the pre-fix tree — including the infeasible `(WATCHLIST_MIN_WIDTH, RIGHT_DOCK_MIN_WIDTH)` = `(150, 200)` — because the new parameter defaults to `False`.

AC4 — AP-D44-5 (the constant's value + the delegate) — Given the module constants and helpers, Then `WATCHLIST_COLLAPSED_WIDTH == 30`; `WATCHLIST_MIN_WIDTH`, `DEFAULT_WATCHLIST_WIDTH` and `RIGHT_DOCK_MIN_WIDTH` keep their existing values; the documented `CHART_MIN_WIDTH` cross-module invariant is unchanged; and `clamp_watchlist_width(width, chart_area_w)` remains the **expanded** rule (it delegates to `plan_watchlist_width(..., collapsed=False)` and never returns the collapsed width).

tests.description: Parametrize `plan_watchlist_width` over (chart_area_w, requested_left) pairs (below the 150 floor, mid-range, at/over the 50% cap) and both `collapsed` values.
tests.expected_result: The collapsed branch returns exactly `WATCHLIST_COLLAPSED_WIDTH` for every pair; the expanded branch equals the previous `max(WATCHLIST_MIN_WIDTH, min(requested_left, watchlist_max_width(chart_area_w)))` formula.

tests.description: Parametrize `plan_dock_widths(..., left_collapsed=True)` over the existing T52 grid (the same grid as `test_dock_layout.py::test_T52_T04`) plus a deliberately infeasible narrow window.

memory_notes: 2026-10-03 (ESC-026): “A cross-clamp shrink loop that decrements dock widths without re-flooring can drive a width below its own dock minimum … Any ‘shrink until it fits’ loop must re-check the floor each iteration and fall through to the other dock when the preferred one is already at its minimum. tasks.title: ui/main_window.py — the collapsed-aware `_apply_dock_widths` (both clamp branches) + the corrected `test_D21_10_T03` collapsed-width leg
tasks.description: Make the single dock-width apply entry point collapsed-aware. In `_apply_dock_widths` read the watchlist collapse state into a **new local** (`watchlist_collapsed` — do not shadow the existing `collapsed`, which is the *right region’s* state): the right-dock-visible branch forwards `left_collapsed=watchlist_collapsed` to `_plan_dock_widths` (which forwards it to the pure helper); the right-dock-hidden branch computes `desired = plan_watchlist_width(chart_area, base_left, collapsed=watchlist_collapsed)` instead of the unconditional `max(WATCHLIST_MIN_WIDTH, …)` clamp. `self._watchlist_width` is **never assigned while collapsed** (it is the tracked previous width `AC-D44.2` restores), and `_dock_widths_consistent` becomes collapsed-aware. Correct `tests/test_watchlist_columns_d21.py::test_D21_10_T03`’s collapsed-width assertion to the collapsed width and move the `>= WATCHLIST_MIN_WIDTH` leg to the **expanded** state.
acceptance_criteria: AC1 — AC-D44.5 (the collapsed width is honoured, right-dock-visible branch) — Given a collapsed watchlist, When `_apply_dock_widths` runs its right-dock-visible branch (via `_plan_dock_widths` → `plan_dock_widths(..., left_collapsed=True)`), Then the planned left width is `WATCHLIST_COLLAPSED_WIDTH` and the 150px expanded minimum is not applied.

AC2 — AC-D44.5 (the collapsed width is honoured, right-dock-hidden branch) — Given a collapsed watchlist **and the right dock hidden**, When `_apply_dock_widths` runs its direct clamp, Then the desired left is `plan_watchlist_width(chart_area, base_left, collapsed=True)` = the collapsed width, not `max(WATCHLIST_MIN_WIDTH, min(base_left, cap))`.

AC3 — AC-D44.2 / AP-D44-2 (the tracked previous width) — Given a collapsed watchlist, Then `self._watchlist_width` is **not** reassigned while collapsed — it keeps the width the dock held immediately before collapsing.

AC4 — AC-D44.8 / AC-D13.1 / AC-D17.2 (the expanded path is unchanged) — Given an expanded watchlist, Then `_apply_dock_widths` produces today’s results in both branches (the 150px minimum, the 50% cap, the B3 cross-clamp, the infeasible result) and `self._watchlist_width` is assigned as today.

AC5 — AC-D44.8 / R67 (the correction is intent-preserving) — Given `tests/test_watchlist_columns_d21.py::test_D21_10_T03`, Then its collapsed-width assertion asserts the **collapsed** width while collapsed, and the `>= WATCHLIST_MIN_WIDTH` leg is asserted in the **expanded** state — not deleted, skipped or relaxed.

tasks.description: Add the D44 collapsed appearance to the panel. A custom `CollapsedWatchlistBar(QWidget)` (fixed `WATCHLIST_COLLAPSED_WIDTH`, `WA_StyledBackground`, an object-name stylesheet in the app palette `#141822` / `#232938` / `#cbd5e1`, a `paintEvent` drawing `WATCHLIST` rotated 90° counter-clockwise and centred, an `expand_requested` signal, `set_button_active` hover/pressed). `WatchlistPanel.collapsed_bar` (the panel’s full-height collapsed body) and `::collapsed_handle` (the 30×28 collapsed title-bar handle). `::_apply_collapsed_visual()` explicitly hides/shows `header_bar` (which carries the D22.1 `+` and the D39.1 search box) and `table` (whose `horizontalHeader()` is the column-header row), and shows/hides the bar. `collapsed_changed = pyqtSignal(bool)` emitted from `_on_header_toggled`; clicking the bar expands the panel. `WATCHLIST_COLLAPSED_WIDTH` is aliased from `dock_layout`. Add the new `tests/test_watchlist_collapsed_bar_d44.py`.
acceptance_criteria: AC1 — AC-D44.1 / AC-D44.6 / A75 (the bar’s form + palette) — Given the panel is collapsed, Then `collapsed_bar` exists and is visible as the panel’s full-height collapsed body at width `WATCHLIST_COLLAPSED_WIDTH`, and its object-name stylesheet uses the app palette (`#141822` background, `#232938` border, `#cbd5e1` text) — **not** white.

AC2 — AC-D44.1 (the rotated label) — Given the bar, Then it paints the text `WATCHLIST` rotated 90° counter-clockwise (a custom `paintEvent`; Qt cannot rotate a `QPushButton`’s text), centred in the bar.

AC3 — AC-D44.4 / A77 (the hidden affordances) — Given the panel is collapsed, Then `header_bar` (carrying the D22.1 `+` and the D39.1 search box) and `table` (whose `horizontalHeader()` is the column-header row) are **not** visible; When the panel expands, Then they are visible again.

AC4 — AC-D44.3 (the collapse API preserved + click-to-expand) — Given `is_collapsed` / `set_collapsed` / `toggle_collapsed`, Then their signatures and semantics are unchanged (collapsing from the retained header button still works); and clicking `collapsed_bar` (or `collapsed_handle`) expands the panel.

AC5 — AC-D44.6 (hover/pressed via the shared convention) — Given the bar, Then its hover/press feedback is applied through `ui/visual_conventions.py::set_button_active` (the `active` dynamic property) and the `[active="true"]` style differs from the idle style — no hand-rolled highlight.

AC6 — AP-D44-5 (the constant alias agreement) — Given the module, Then `ui/watchlist_panel.WATCHLIST_COLLAPSED_WIDTH` equals `ui/dock_layout.WATCHLIST_COLLAPSED_WIDTH`, and `CHART_MIN_WIDTH` remains equal in both modules.

AC7 — AC-D44.1 / A78 (the collapsed title-bar handle) — Given the collapsed state, Then `collapsed_handle` exists as a 30px-wide, 28px-tall widget suitable for the dock’s title-bar slot (the swap itself is wired in P3-T05).
